name: vm-manager-proxmox
description: Manage Proxmox VE virtual machines, nodes, power actions and metrics from VS Code.

vmm.proxmox.rememberSession.markdownDescription: Keep the Proxmox sign-in (OpenID Connect or password) in the operating system keychain after VS Code closes or reloads, so the next start reuses it while it is valid (Proxmox sessions last 2 hours) instead of asking again. Off: the session is forgotten when VS Code closes. **Sign Out** always removes it.

vmManager.providers.description: Remote Proxmox VE clusters over HTTPS
